newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-BOURSE TURNOVER IN JULY UP TO 2.15 BLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-BOURSE TURNOVER IN JULY UP TO 2.15 BLN KROONS.

text.p: Total turnover on the Tallinn stock exchange during July was 2.15 billion kroons, almost double June's 1.1 billion kroons, the exchange said on Friday.
The Talse index was 29.09 percent higher at the end of the month to close at a record high of 356.60 points.

The biggest gainers in July were Hoiupank which rose by 47.4 percent to end the month at 221.45 kroons and Hansapank , which gained 33.40 percent to end at 196.10 kroons, the exchange said in a statement.
Uhispank closely followed to pick up 28.80 percent to end July on 69.10 kroons.
The biggest losers on the main list were Tallinna Kaubamaja and Baltika.
The Kaubamaja department store share price was 12.41 percent lower and Baltika, a clothing manufacturer and retailer, was 6.59 percent down.
